target.class_name: Anh văn chuyên ngành Cơ khí
target.lesson_title: Chapter 7: Metal Forming and Casting — Gia công kim loại bằng biến dạng và đúc

exam.title: Kiểm tra từ vựng Chapter 7: Metal Forming and Casting
exam.topic: AVCN C7: Metal Forming and Casting

questions.question: What does crankshaft mean?
options: mép gờ (phần rìa của tấm phôi kim loại)
questions.explanation: crankshaft = trục khuỷu.
questions.topic: AVCN C7: Metal Forming and Casting

questions.question: Which English word means “khuôn”?
questions.explanation: die: A shaping tool that metal is pressed or poured into.
questions.topic: AVCN C7: Metal Forming and Casting

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
Heating compressed metal powder, without melting it, until the particles join together.
questions.explanation: sintering = thiêu kết (nung bột kim loại cho dính lại).
questions.topic: AVCN C7: Metal Forming and Casting

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A hollow shape that gives liquid metal its form.
questions.explanation: mould = khuôn đúc.
questions.topic: AVCN C7: Metal Forming and Casting

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A process in which a machining tool makes a round or other shaped hole in raw metal.
questions.explanation: piercing = đột lỗ.
questions.topic: AVCN C7: Metal Forming and Casting

questions.question: Which English word means “ép tạo hình quay (miết)”?
questions.explanation: spinning: A process in which a metal disc or tube is rotated at high speed and formed into a round part.
questions.topic: AVCN C7: Metal Forming and Casting

questions.question: Which English word means “lò nung (lò nấu kim loại)”?
questions.explanation: furnace: A very hot chamber used for heating or melting metal.
questions.topic: AVCN C7: Metal Forming and Casting

questions.question: What does recrystallization temperature mean?
options: đe (bệ thép để đặt phôi khi rèn)
phế liệu, phần thừa bỏ đi
nhiệt độ kết tinh lại (mốc chia gia công nóng và gia công nguội)
questions.explanation: recrystallization temperature = nhiệt độ kết tinh lại (mốc chia gia công nóng và gia công nguội).
questions.topic: AVCN C7: Metal Forming and Casting

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A model of the part, used to make the cavity in a sand mold.
questions.explanation: pattern = mẫu đúc.
questions.topic: AVCN C7: Metal Forming and Casting

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
Plastic deformation of metals below the recrystallization temperature.
questions.explanation: cold-working = gia công nguội.
questions.topic: AVCN C7: Metal Forming and Casting

questions.question: Which English word means “gia công nóng”?
questions.explanation: hot-working: Plastic deformation of metals above their recrystallization temperature.
questions.topic: AVCN C7: Metal Forming and Casting

questions.question: Which English word means “cắt (tấm kim loại bằng hai lưỡi cắt)”?
questions.explanation: shearing: Cutting sheet metal with two blades, without making chips.
questions.topic: AVCN C7: Metal Forming and Casting

questions.question: Which English word means “cán (kim loại)”?
questions.explanation: rolling: Passing metal between rollers to reduce its thickness.
questions.topic: AVCN C7: Metal Forming and Casting

questions.question: Which English word means “ép đùn”?
questions.explanation: extrusion: Forcing heated metal through a die to make long bars or tubes.
questions.topic: AVCN C7: Metal Forming and Casting

questions.question: What does ingot mean?
questions.explanation: ingot = thỏi kim loại đúc sẵn.
questions.topic: AVCN C7: Metal Forming and Casting

questions.question: What does flange mean?
options: đe (bệ thép để đặt phôi khi rèn)
mép gờ (phần rìa của tấm phôi kim loại)
questions.explanation: flange = mép gờ (phần rìa của tấm phôi kim loại).
questions.topic: AVCN C7: Metal Forming and Casting

questions.question: Which English word means “đúc cát”?
questions.explanation: sand casting: A manufacturing process in which liquid metal is poured into a sand mold.
questions.topic: AVCN C7: Metal Forming and Casting

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A method of metal casting in which molten metal is poured into a mold made by means of a wax model.
questions.explanation: investment casting = đúc sáp chảy (đúc mẫu chảy).
questions.topic: AVCN C7: Metal Forming and Casting

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
The process in which metals are formed using compressive forces.
questions.explanation: forging = rèn.
questions.topic: AVCN C7: Metal Forming and Casting

questions.question: What does heat resistance mean?
questions.explanation: heat resistance = khả năng chịu nhiệt.
questions.topic: AVCN C7: Metal Forming and Casting

questions.question: Which English word means “uốn, gập”?
questions.explanation: bending: A process by which metal is deformed at an angle when force is applied.
questions.topic: AVCN C7: Metal Forming and Casting

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A sheet metal forming process where a punch forces the sheet to pull in from the flange area.
questions.explanation: deep drawing = dập vuốt sâu.
questions.topic: AVCN C7: Metal Forming and Casting

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
Heating metal until it is molten and pouring it into a mould.
questions.explanation: casting = đúc.
questions.topic: AVCN C7: Metal Forming and Casting

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A process where materials get plastic deformation to obtain the required shape.
questions.explanation: metal-forming = gia công kim loại bằng biến dạng, tạo hình kim loại.
questions.topic: AVCN C7: Metal Forming and Casting

questions.question: Which English word means “nóng chảy, ở thể lỏng”?
questions.explanation: molten: Melted into a liquid by heat.
questions.topic: AVCN C7: Metal Forming and Casting
